Consolidation of papers 192–198 (issues #335–#341, exps 545–553).

**THE TWO-TREE CLOSURE.** The energy-ascent question — can a magnitude spectrum computed from N climb the Berggren/Price trees toward the semiprime's node? — is answered NO, sealed at FOUR strengths: (1) residue dials blind (paper 81 replicated); (2) Gauss-sum magnitudes PROVEN residue dials (N mod 720720); (3) bracket/sign-count sensors structurally constant (MI=0.000000 exactly, identities proven); (4) spectral summaries RETRACTED to magnitude mirrors of |N| (exact null given log-N deciles). Only a factor-derived oracle bound remains (I peaks 0.4798 bits @ B≈22758), unrealized by every tested probe.

Exact laws banked: Price two-adic law (letter₀=A ⟺ N≡1 mod 4; letter₁=A ⟺ N mod 8 ∈{1,3}; bijection with N mod 8; v₂(p+q)-capped mechanism; provable death at position 2); ascent economics (restart E=h·α^(−h); branching base pinned at 3 ∀α<1; win-vs-Fermat needs α*≥0.85 & c≤3000); sequential hints COMPOUND where the class-hint master law saturates — new taxonomy entry. Corrections: dP slope 1.211 not 1.4; dB/Fermat anticorrelation stratum-dependent.

Method laws banked lab-wide: row-shuffle nulls are WRONG for deterministic functions of N (condition on magnitude instead); derivation-first validation; smoke-run checks as mechanism detectors.

What would reopen it: a probe class none of the four sealed kinds, non-monotone in |N|, delivering per-step accuracy above α*≈0.85 at cost ≤3000 visit-equivalents. The geometry contains up to 0.48 bits of positional content; nothing cheap reads it.

Honest headline: the relaxation turns an uncomputable search (~2^56 units) into a trial-division-class one (~2^16) — ~10^12× better than blind, yet still dominated by ρ (α=0.458). Every route through the tree's integer face ends in a known method.

concept.concept_description: The sequence of primes 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, ... defines a point cloud in R where the n-th prime p_n is at position p_n on the real line. The gaps between primes create a topological structure. Define the persistent homology of the prime point cloud as the Rips filtration R_epsilon = {p_n : |p_m - p_n| <= epsilon}. As epsilon increases, more primes are connected, and the topology changes. Conjecture: The persistent H_0 (connected components) of the prime point cloud has the same barcode as a Poisson point process with intensity 1/log(x).
